parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run without modifying the service resource.
- **false** (default): Sends a normal request.

parameters.name: EcrId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated ECR.

parameters.name: EcrOwnerAliUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECR instance belongs.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VBR**
- **VPC**
